artboards.title: Identity · the mark and its system

annotations.text: homepage-v1 — the founder-approved homepage and identity, 2026-09-08. Round 2 (2026-09-09) changed copy and section order only: the two priced product rows moved above every editorial section, and every sentence now speaks in the first person (spec 004 §14 A5). The visual system — paper, ramp, type pairing, spacing, finder card, colophon — is untouched. See homepage-v1/README.md, 'Round 2, founder direction'.

Density (founder, 2026-09-09): products with prices before prose; larger photography slots; plain warm copy over abstract labels; real occasion dates in the category row; the delivery promise — date, cutoff in the recipient's time, fee on the chip — wherever a product is shown. The price slot stays a Placeholder bar because country_price has no rows yet; it renders the all-in amount the day it does.
